title: Fpqc descent of sections of a small etale sheaf
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\{g_i:T_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Write $g_i^{-1}F$ for the etale inverse image of sheaves of sets [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], and $g_{ij}:T_i\times_ST_j\to S$ for the structure morphism. Then the canonical map from $\Gamma(S,F)$ to the equalizer of $\prod_i\Gamma(T_i,g_i^{-1}F)\rightrightarrows\prod_{i,j}\Gamma(T_i\times_ST_j,g_{ij}^{-1}F)$, with arrows given by pullback along the two projections (identifying $\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}g_i^{-1}F$ and $\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}g_j^{-1}F$ with $g_{ij}^{-1}F$ by the composition isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]), is bijective. In particular, for a singleton fpqc covering $g:T\to S$, a section of $g^{-1}F$ descends uniquely to $F$ exactly when its two pullbacks to $T\times_ST$ agree.
